About CirrusMD:

CirrusMD is redefining virtual care by delivering a Physician-first Care & Guidance solution that meets patients at their moment of need. Our text-based (or web) app connects patients with licensed physicians in under a minute, allowing them to engage in care at their own pace and convenience. Available 24/7/365, CirrusMD’s integrated care spans multiple specialties—from acute and chronic care to behavioral health. Our platform serves 10 million users across all 50 states and is offered exclusively through employers and health plans. Learn more at cirrusmd.com .

About the role

There’s data everywhere. The real value comes from knowing what it means, what matters, and what we should do next.

That’s where you come in.

As a Lead Business Intelligence Analyst at CirrusMD, you’ll sit at the intersection of data, technology, healthcare, and business strategy. You’ll partner with teams across Product, Clinical, Client Success, Finance, and Engineering to turn complex questions into trusted data, meaningful insights, and better decisions.

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply take requests and build dashboards.

You’ll help shape how CirrusMD measures success, demonstrates the value of our solutions, and builds a stronger data-informed culture. You’ll be comfortable talking strategy with business leaders one minute and getting into SQL, LookML, data models, or reporting logic the next.

If you love digging into complex data, connecting dots others might miss, and turning analysis into action, we’d love to meet you.

Location: This position can work remotely from anywhere within the U.S.

What you'll do (Essential Responsibilities)

Connect data to the business. Serve as a trusted data partner across Product, Clinical, Client Success, Finance, and Engineering, helping teams connect business goals with technical execution.

Show the value. Build measurement frameworks that translate our product, clinical, and commercial work into meaningful performance metrics and help demonstrate the value and ROI of CirrusMD’s solutions.

Own the data journey. Lead analytics projects from the first question and feasibility assessment through modeling, analysis, reporting, and client-facing delivery.

Build data people can trust. Partner with Engineering to define data structures and strengthen our Looker semantic layer, creating scalable, reusable, high-confidence data.

Turn complexity into clarity. Dig into complex datasets and uncover insights that help teams understand what’s happening, why it matters, and where we should go next.

Bring performance to life. Build thoughtful dashboards, visualizations, and reporting frameworks that make important metrics understandable and actionable.

Protect the integrity of the data. Balance client and stakeholder needs with strong governance, privacy standards, and organizational data practices.

Get into the weeds when it matters. Investigate anomalies, challenge assumptions, validate results, and make sure the story the data tells is actually true.

Help us get smarter. Identify opportunities to evolve our analytics capabilities, improve existing data models, reduce technical debt, and make trusted insights easier to access across the organization.

Take on other responsibilities as needed to support our clients, teams, and business.

What you'll bring (Qualifications)

Experience: 5+ years of relevant analytics or business intelligence experience.

Strong to advanced SQL skills and experience working with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.

Hands-on experience with business intelligence platforms such as Looker.

Experience building and maintaining semantic layers using LookML.

Experience using GitHub or similar version-control practices within a modern analytics environment.

A track record of translating complex or ambiguous business questions into well-defined technical and analytical solutions.

Experience owning analytics work from initial idea through feasibility, modeling, validation, visualization, and delivery.

The ability to build new data solutions while also improving, refactoring, and simplifying existing ones.

Strong two-way communication skills that allow you to explain technical concepts to business partners and translate business needs for technical teams.

Experience balancing complex, client-facing data requests with established data governance standards.

Experience working with high-integrity data processes where accuracy is non-negotiable, such as billing, invoicing, financial, or clinical reporting.

Knowledge and application of analytical and statistical concepts such as confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, sentiment analysis, and anomaly detection.

The ability to manage competing priorities and know when a problem requires a deep dive and when it’s time to zoom back out.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with modern data transformation and orchestration tools such as dbt or Airflow.

Experience using Python or R when the analysis needs to go beyond SQL.

Knowledge of healthcare data and standards, including HIPAA, FedRAMP, PII/PHI, or clinical quality measures such as HEDIS, NCQA, or NQF.

Experience with event-based product analytics or Customer Data Platforms such as Segment.

A strong understanding of modern data architecture and how upstream engineering decisions affect downstream analytics.

Experience working within digital health or the broader U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

Experience using AI to make data easier to access and understand, including natural-language querying, conversational analytics, or AI-enabled self-service BI.

What's in it for you:

CirrusMD is paving the way to a better healthcare future and our work truly matters! Our solution is exceptionally accessible, instantly available, and simply scalable. If you are looking to make a lasting impact where your voice matters, consider joining our team and help us deliver care without barriers. We take the health and happiness of our employees seriously and offer great benefits including:

Competitive compensation

Deeply subsidized medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family

Unlimited PTO / Vacation

401(K) + match

Paid maternity & paternity leave

Remote friendly

Growth opportunity

A positive, collaborative and diverse culture

Social events onsite & remote

Free, unlimited access to our text-first platform

Reasonable Accommodation:

Should you require reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the application/interview/selection process, or in order to complete the essential duties of the position upon acceptance of a job offer, click here to submit a recruitment accommodation request.

Recruiting Scams:

Unfortunately, scams targeting job seekers are common. To protect our candidates, we want to remind you that authorized representatives of Quantum Health will only contact you from an email address ending in @quantum-health.com. Quantum Health will never ask for personally identifiable information such as Date of Birth (DOB), Social Security Number (SSN), banking/direct/tax details, etc. via email or any other non-secure system, nor will we instruct you to make any purchases related to your employment. If you believe you’ve encountered a recruiting scam, report it to the Federal Trade Commission and your state’s Attorney General .

California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information:

If you are a California resident, Quantum Health may collect personal information in connection with your application for employment and, if hired, during the course of your employment. The categories of personal information collected and the purposes for which that information is used are described in our California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information.

Please review the notice here:

California Employee and Job Applicant Notice

Use of Technology Notice:

Quantum Health and its authorized service providers may contact applicants by email, phone, and text message about their application and related employment opportunities. Job Summary

The Business Intelligence Analyst plays a critical role in transforming data into meaningful, accurate, and actionable insights that support strategic decision-making, operational performance, and financial discipline across the organization. This role is responsible for designing and delivering scalable business intelligence solutions, including interactive dashboards, reporting tools, data models, and analytical frameworks that help leaders better understand trends, measure performance, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions.

This position serves as both a technical analytics resource and a cross-functional business partner, working closely with Finance, Operations, HR, Marketing, IT, and senior leadership to translate complex business questions into reliable data solutions. The BI Analyst will gather requirements, define and standardize key performance indicators, build and maintain data pipelines and reporting structures, validate data accuracy, and present insights in a clear, practical, and business-oriented manner. Success in this role requires strong technical capability in SQL, Python, BI tools, and cloud-based data platforms, combined with curiosity, sound business judgment, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Essential Job Functions

Business Intelligence, Reporting & Dashboard Development

• Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards, visualizations, and self-service reporting tools using Sigma, Power BI, , or similar platforms.

• Translate raw data from accounting, financial systems, operations, HR, marketing, and other business areas into clear, accurate, and actionable reporting outputs.

• Develop recurring and ad hoc reports that communicate KPIs, trends, variance analysis, performance drivers, and business implications.

Data Engineering, Modeling & Integration

• Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines using SQL, Python, PySpark, cloud-based orchestration tools, APIs, databases, flat files, and third-party platforms.

• Build and maintain data models, schemas, semantic layers, and warehouse structures, including dimensional models, to support consistent and scalable reporting and analytics.

• Write and optimize complex SQL queries, tune data workflows, and improve data storage, retrieval, processing performance, and reliability across reporting environments.

Advanced Analytics & Emerging Technology Support

• Support forecasting, segmentation, optimization, experimentation, and data science initiatives by preparing reliable datasets, curated inputs, and scalable data assets.

• Evaluate and apply AI-enabled analytics tools, including generative AI and large language models, to improve reporting automation, data exploration, insight generation, and business productivity.

• Use AI and LLM-enabled tools responsibly by following appropriate data privacy, security, governance, validation, and documentation standards.

Business Partnership & Performance Insights

• Partner with leaders and stakeholders across Finance, Operations, HR, Marketing, IT, analytics, and senior leadership to understand business needs, define reporting requirements, and align data initiatives with organizational priorities.

• Define and standardize key performance indicators, support budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance analysis, and identify opportunities for cost optimization, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.

Data Governance, Quality & Process Improvement

• Ensure data integrity, consistency, security, and compliance by implementing validation checks, access controls, monitoring, documentation, and governance standards.

• Perform data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis to resolve data discrepancies, reporting issues, and process gaps.

• Automate manual reporting processes, improve data workflows, document business logic and reporting standards, and stay current with BI, analytics, AI, and data engineering technologies.
Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

• 3–7+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, data engineering, or a related role supporting both technical data solutions and business decision-making.

• Strong SQL skills, including data extraction, transformation, query optimization, and work within relational database or data warehouse environments.

• Proficiency with Python for data preparation, automation, analysis, and pipeline support; experience with PySpark or distributed data processing is a plus.

• Hands-on experience building or supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, semantic layers, and scalable reporting datasets using cloud-based or modern data platforms, specifically Databricks & Snowflake.

• Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Sigma, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms, including dashboard development and KPI reporting.

• Experience with Azure Synapse Analytics or related Azure data services, including pipelines, notebooks, linked services, and integration components, is a plus.

• Relevant certification in data engineering, cloud platforms, business intelligence, analytics, or AI-enabled analytics is a plus.

• Demonstrated experience using AI/LLM tools to materially improve analytics workflows, automation, or efficiencies — with specific examples of what you built, used, or automated. Experience in a multi-site or operations-driven environment such as retail, fitness, healthcare, hospitality, or QSR is a plus.

• Ability to translate business questions into analytical requirements and communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Competencies

• Analytical problem-solving, critical thinking, and intellectual curiosity.

• Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, documentation, and quality control.

• Clear communication and storytelling skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
